definitions.explanation: The chain of islands that makes up Japan: the four main islands of Hokkaido, Honshu, Shikoku, and Kyushu and thousands of smaller ones, stretching from north to south. Common in weather reports and in talk about the country as a physical whole.

examples.japanese: {日本列島|にほんれっとう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{南北|なんぼく}→南北：04287_nanboku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧。
examples.english: The Japanese archipelago is long from north to south.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寒波|かんぱ}→寒波：12354_kanpa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{日本列島|にほんれっとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覆|おお}っている→覆う：02020_oou⟧。
examples.english: A cold wave is covering the Japanese islands.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{日本列島|にほんれっとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{縦断|じゅうだん}→縦断：09035_juudan⟧し、⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: A large typhoon swept the length of Japan, causing damage in many places.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日本列島|にほんれっとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{縦断|じゅうだん}→縦断：09035_juudan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to travel (or sweep) the length of Japan
- {日本列島|にほんれっとう}⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧: all over Japan
- {日本列島|にほんれっとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{襲|おそ}う→襲う：01915_osou⟧: to strike Japan (of storms, cold waves)

USAGE:
Weather and disaster reports often use ⟦{列島|れっとう}→列島：11739_rettou⟧ alone for Japan as a whole, as in ⟦{列島|れっとう}→列島：11739_rettou⟧⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{猛暑日|もうしょび}→猛暑日：09622_moushobi⟧ (scorching heat all over Japan).
